source_manifest.scope: San Francisco, Phoenix and Los Angeles; Austin has no cell data in this release.
dependencies: Published passenger-vehicle non-Dynamic benchmark rates, event classifications, HPMS mileage and allocated benchmark counts are supplied by Waymo.
The relative spatial factor is reconstructed; raw human crash records, mileage calibration and event adjudication are not independently reconstructed.
source_notes: Retain all 523 event rows using source CSV row number; two missing SGO IDs and one ID repeated across cities are preserved, not deduplicated.
City totals are rounded to 0.001 million miles in CSV1. Cell mileage is lower than city totals; show the gap without assigning a cause.
Cell mileage is repeated across outcomes. Count unique geographic cells and use only the selected outcome when weighting.
Reporting-adjusted injury benchmarks already incorporate the publisher reporting adjustment. Do not apply it twice.
source_manifest.uncertainty: Displayed scenario intervals condition on fixed benchmark rates, spatial weights and exposure. Only Waymo count uncertainty is included; published full rate-ratio intervals are not reproduced.
